summary: Tested the new admin 'Calendario generale operatori' feature end-to-end. BACKEND: added TestAdminCalendar (10 tests) to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering GET /api/admin/calendar (401 no auth, 403 partner role, 400 bad start format, 422 missing start, response shape {partners,slots} with only email/name/premium/professione/zone_coperte and no _id/password_hash, Premium-first sorting, only approved partners, suspended partner hidden, partner-set 'occupato' slot visible with request_id/cliente null, assigned slot exposing cliente 'Nome Cognome' + tipo_intervento, Sunday (start+6) excluded from the window). Full regression suite: 30 passed, 1 skipped (edge-answered CORS preflight), 0 failed - includes iteration_2 partner-availability/assignment tests. FRONTEND E2E (Playwright, 1920x1600, public preview URL): tab 'Calendario' present in the right position (requests, partners, calendar, reviews) and renders the grid with both active operators; week label '17 ago - 22 ago', prev disabled at current week, next enabled, next disabled at week+2 ('31 ago - 5 set') and a forced extra click does not move it; past cells data-status=passato and disabled ('-'); andrea Pinna 25/08 mattina = data-status occupato, text 'Occ.', disabled (not clickable). SHORTCUT: click on a free cell (Luca Prati 25/08 pomeriggio) opens cal-shortcut-dialog titled 'Luca Prati - 25 ago, Pomeriggio (13-18)' listing the 14 unassigned requests with cliente, tipo, indirizzo and 'Preferenza: 25 ago Mattina (8-13)'; clicking a request assigns it (toast 'Assegnato a Luca Prati: 25 ago - Pomeriggio (13-18)'), the dialog closes and the cell turns data-status=assegnato showing the client name with padlock. Requests tab reflects the assignment immediately without reload (assigned-to-{id} 'Luca Prati / assegnata / 29/08/2026 - Pomeriggio (13-18)'). Clicking the assigned cell opens request-detail-dialog with all fields (preferenze cliente, SLOT ASSEGNATO '25/08/2026 - Pomeriggio (13-18)'); reassigning from there to 27/08 mattina works (toast) and after reopening the tab the calendar shows 25/08 pom back to libero and 27/08 mattina assegnato. Empty state verified by stubbing GET /api/requests -> 'Nessuna richiesta in attesa di assegnazione.' (cal-shortcut-empty). SYNC verified with a second browser context: Luca marks 28/08 mattina occupied from his own dashboard -> admin calendar shows 'Occ.' disabled; freeing it restores libero. Filters: professione options ['Tutte le professioni','Idraulico'], zona ['Tutte le zone','Varese','varese como']; combined prof+zona narrows to a single operator row and 'Tutte...' restores both rows. No console errors (only the expected 401 from /auth/me before login). All test data removed: 0 TEST_ requests, 0 residual slots for luca.prati (approved=true, suspended=false), andrea.pinna054 slots untouched.

minor.issue: Sunday assignments are accepted (200) but the calendars only render Mon-Sat, so the created availability_slot is invisible to both admin and partner (verified: assign date 2026-08-30 -> 200, slot absent from /admin/calendar for both start=2026-08-24 and start=2026-08-31). Either reject weekday==6 with a 400 or add a Sunday column.

zone_coperte/professione come from partner_applications with no normalization: the zona dropdown shows 'Varese' and 'varese como' as two distinct options (only ',' is used as separator and casing is not normalized), so zone filtering can silently miss operators.

issues: Assigned cells truncate the client name to ~70px ('TESTUI_A C...'); the title attribute tooltip does not include the client name, only partner/day/fascia/status - consider adding the client to the title
The 'Occ.' orange-on-dark and the assigned white/10 cells are fine, but there is no legend entry for the past '-' state
Grid has min-w-[1100px] with horizontal scroll: on tablet/mobile the operator name column scrolls away (no sticky first column)
Assignment day still uses the native browser date input (MM/DD/YYYY in an Italian UI) instead of the shadcn calendar

action_items: Reject (400) assignments on Sunday in PATCH /api/requests/{id}/assign, or render a Sunday column - currently such bookings are invisible in every calendar
Normalize professione/zone_coperte (trim + case-insensitive dedupe, split on ',' and ';') before building the filter dropdowns
Optional polish: sticky operator column on small screens, client name in the cell tooltip, legend entry for past slots
critical_code_review_comments: AdminCalendar.jsx: the shortcut list uses `requests` from the parent, filtered with `!r.assigned_to && r.status !== 'completata'`, while the backend has its own assignability rules - if the parent list is stale (another admin assigned meanwhile) the click returns 409/400; the error toast is shown correctly but the list is not refreshed. Consider reloading requests on 409.

AdminCalendar.jsx: `useEffect(load, [week])` does not abort the in-flight request when the week changes quickly; rapid prev/next clicks can render a stale week's slots. Add an ignore flag / AbortController.
MAX_WEEK_OFFSET=2 is duplicated in AdminCalendar.jsx, AvailabilityCalendar and SLOT_HORIZON_DAYS=21 in server.py - extract a shared constant (already raised in iteration_2).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 8 requested calendar flows verified

rca_of_the_issue: Sunday blind spot RCA: parse_slot_date only validates the ISO format and the assign endpoint checks past date + 21-day horizon + fascia, but never the weekday; GET /admin/calendar queries date >= start AND date < start+6 days, i.e. Mon..Sat, and the FE renders 6 columns - so a slot created on a Sunday is stored (blocking that partner's double-booking check) yet never displayed in any week. Zona dropdown duplication RCA: AdminCalendar builds the zone list with (zone_coperte||'').split(',') without trim-lowercase dedupe, and partner_applications store free text ('varese como').
